intent: Implement the approved Work Unit within scope and return a verifiable handoff.
steps: Confirm the Work Unit is READY or IN_PROGRESS and required execution gates are satisfied
Read the Context Package and applicable governance policies
Stay within Work Unit scope and expected behavior
Implement the smallest coherent change that satisfies observable behavior and contracts
Add or update developer-owned tests when required by the Work Unit verification plan
Run required checks declared by the Work Unit
Create a coherent commit on the isolated Work Unit branch referencing the Work Unit identifier
Return a structured handoff with changed files, behavior implemented, commands and tests run, commit SHA, limitations, open questions, contract changes, and evidence candidates
invariants: Do not broaden Work Unit scope
Do not merge to protected branches or deploy production without authorization
Do not invent missing product decisions
Do not present a work-in-progress checkpoint as verified
